reduction.vreduce_signature_assumption: vec_reduce_max/vec_reduce_add(mask, dst, src, work, repeat_times, src_rep_stride) with one call over all 64 repeats leaving the row result in dst[0]; confirmed for vec_reduce_add by the executed Round61/62 AdaLN norm, assumed identical for vec_reduce_max (same vreduce family, vcmax registered). Root build/probe is the authority; the author never compiled this kernel.
reduction.partial_ub_slice_operands: s_f[valid_keys] is used as a vector_dup destination so only the 64-slot key tail is written; the project FA patch already passes offset tensor slices to vector_dup (scores[block, 0, 0]).
